reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 2.7 is ordinary IP/anti-reverse-engineering protection, not a restraint on Corio's business, and Section 13.6 affirmatively preserves each party's independent development rights.

The CORIO MARKET SEGMENT and TERRITORY definitions delimit the scope of the license granted to us rather than prohibiting us from operating businesses or buying/building competing products; the rationale correctly notes this and that expansion can be sought, so treating it as within the preferred position is defensible and not an over- or under-flag.
No redline or comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
